Name: Frame delivery
Statement: During imaging the payload shall deliver calibrated frames at a rate of at least 2 Hz.

Name: Image processing
Statement: During imaging the processor shall produce each calibrated frame within 400 ms.

Name: Status reporting
Statement: The controller shall report a detected sensor fault within 100 ms.
Notes: Detection semantics defined in interface document

Name: Fault warning
Statement: The unit shall provide an appropriate warning quickly.
